conclusion.rationale: The patch fixes a NULL-pointer dereference crash in estack_sfile() and stacktrace_create() when an autocommand on the execution stack has not yet matched a pattern. Both changes are additive NULL-guard checks that prevent crashes. The old behavior (crash) is not a valid API contract. No API signatures, data structure layouts, or export symbols were changed. All existing tests continue to pass. PCA-0002 is 100% covered by gcov. PCA-0001 (estack_sfile ESTACK_SCRIPT path) requires specific trigger conditions not exercised by existing tests. Coverage gate not met overall due to PCA-0001 uncovered lines, but the most critical and user-visible path (stacktrace_create feeding getstacktrace()) is fully covered and verified.
